Instead, it continues traversing deeper levels for non-empty channels until they also reach an empty or homogeneous state (or until all channels are empty). The text confirms: 'Because we have to take all visible channels into account, we can not skip a node if it is only empty for one channel. It further explains that 'another channel might require a few more traversal steps to reach a subdivision level in which the corresponding node is empty,' ensuring no visible data is skipped due to strictly decreasing spatial extents.
